title: Routing issue in v4
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
After upgrading to 4.0.0 the routing seems no longer works out-of-the-box. queries in browser address bar are escaped in an unusual way:

Config:

```js
const search = instantsearch({
  indexName: 'index',
  searchParameters: {
    facetingAfterDistinct: true,
    attributesToSnippet: ['extended:40'],
  },
  routing: true,
  searchClient,
  ...
});
```

In 4.0.0:

```
/?list%5Bquery%5D=keyword
```

The following is how it looks with 3.7.0:

```
/?query=keyword
```

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to the official demo https://instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/media/
2. Type keyword in the search bar
3. Inspect the address bar
4. See how queries got escaped

**Expected behavior 💭**
The queries should be shown in a more intuitive form just like v3.

**Screenshots 🖥**
In 4.0.0:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/96356/67885913-67aa1c80-fb83-11e9-9e01-0908cb698b7f.png)

In 3.7.0:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/96356/67885988-8dcfbc80-fb83-11e9-97b7-60153d8f372e.png)

**Environment:**

* OS: macOS 10.15 (19A602)
* Browser Google Chrome
* Version 78.0.3904.70
